method.name: intraday_decile_turnover_proxy_v1
method.weights: top +0.5 / k, bottom -0.5 / k; ties at selection boundary share remaining mass equally
method.turnover: 0.5 * sum(abs(weight_t - weight_previous)); both portfolios must have gross 1
method.transitions: adjacent observed timestamps within the same local trading date; no overnight transition
method.stock_changes: weights align on union with zero for absent names; rank persistence uses the intersection
method.rank_persistence: Pearson correlation of average ranks across consecutive cross-sections
method.label_usage: none in signal/position diagnostics; existing local metrics retain original evaluator

limitations: 仅本地未中性化预测的诊断代理，不是平台换手、BARRA、夏普、成本或综合分。
不评估组合收益，不据测试期调参或构造按时点手工切换规则。
单种子；验证和测试均属于持续观察的研究区间。
